title: Delhi High Court seeks report from police on bid to arrest accused despite court protection
description: The Delhi High Court recently sought an explanation from Delhi Police after noting that an investigating officer was granted permission to travel to Mumbai to "search and arrest" an accused despite a court order against arresting the person [Amit Jain v State Govt of NCT of Delhi].Justice Prateek Jalan on July 3 directed the Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP) concerned to examine how the request came to be made and approved despite the existing interim protection and submit a report to the Cour
